interpretation: Reach, capacity and screw strokes transcribed from the 1889 technical account. Diagram informs articulated chassis, level hotte, pivot, jib and ties. Jib/tie lengths, gauge, rail inclination and unlabelled dimensions are authored proportions, not surveyed historical dimensions. Prototype is not yet the production rig. Head G rests 1.00 guide-metres above the carriage nut and main screw I is 4.20 m long, with an authored -0.80 m lateral offset: these clearance proportions are not measurements from the plate. The unloaded climb parks the jib inward at 5.5 m reach. Lowering G clears the working jib from G/I; it does not authorize unrestricted slew through the guide girders. Moving chassis is offset 0.95 m toward the front flange; inclined bronze skates supply the explicit guide contact.
